SELECT 
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_principal_balance,
    pp.annual_income AS annual_income,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS multiple
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
HAVING 
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 2
ORDER BY 
    multiple DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS employee_name,
    so.operator_id,
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS self_loan_contract_count
FROM 
    main.service_operator so
JOIN 
    main.staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN 
    main.party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE 
    so.operator_kind = 'CREDIT_OFFICER'
    AND ca.product_family IN ('WORKING_CAPITAL', 'PROJECT', 'CORPORATE', 'RETAIL', 'SME', 'GREEN', 'TRADE')
GROUP BY 
    p.display_name, so.operator_id, so.authority_level
ORDER BY 
    self_loan_contract_count DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS employee_name,
    ld.loan_id AS loan_id,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount,
    ld.disbursed_on AS disbursed_date
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    account acc ON ld.disbursement_account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON acc.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    staff_member sm ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE 
    ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
    AND acc.is_external = 0
ORDER BY 
    ld.disbursed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    p.party_id AS borrower_id,
    pp.annual_income AS annual_income,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due), 2) AS total_due_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS income_multiple
FROM 
    repayment_schedule rs
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
    AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
ORDER BY 
    income_multiple DESC,
    p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT 
    lpc.product_name_zh AS product_category_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN rs.principal_due ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    loan_product_catalog lpc ON ld.drawdown_type = lpc.product_code
JOIN 
    repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE 
    rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY 
    lpc.product_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30' AND td.maturity_on <= date('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS due_90_days_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on > date('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS due_over_90_days_count
FROM 
    term_deposit td
JOIN 
    account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20
ORDER BY 
    expired_count DESC, 
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS joint_account_count
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, 
    ou.unit_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT ah.party_id) > 1
ORDER BY 
    joint_account_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS overdue_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON ca.managing_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    rs.loan_id,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    repayment_schedule rs
WHERE 
    rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY 
    rs.loan_id
HAVING 
    SUM(rs.principal_due) > 120000000
ORDER BY 
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN rs.interest_due ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_overdue_interest
FROM 
    repayment_schedule rs
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 30
ORDER BY 
    overdue_installment_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS overdue_loan_count
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE 
    rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) >= 240
ORDER BY 
    overdue_loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    rs.loan_id,
    rs.installment_no,
    rs.principal_due,
    rs.interest_due
FROM 
    repayment_schedule rs
WHERE 
    rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
    AND rs.principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY 
    rs.principal_due DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS total_credit_limit,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND((SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital), 4) AS disbursement_to_capital_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON cf.facility_id = (SELECT facility_id FROM credit_agreement WHERE agreement_id = ld.agreement_id)
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING 
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > cs.net_capital
ORDER BY 
    disbursement_to_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE 
    sa.security_type = 'GUARANTEE'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING 
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 
    total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    cf.facility_id,
    cf.limit_amount,
    sc.name_zh AS status_name
FROM 
    credit_facility cf
JOIN 
    status_catalog sc 
    ON sc.entity = 'credit_agreement' 
    AND sc.status_code = cf.status
WHERE 
    cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
ORDER BY 
    cf.limit_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS total_limit_amount
FROM 
    credit_facility cf
JOIN 
    institution i ON cf.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_name, cf.facility_type
HAVING 
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) > 2000000000
ORDER BY 
    total_limit_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    cf.facility_type,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM 
    credit_facility cf
WHERE 
    cf.limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY 
    cf.facility_type
ORDER BY 
    record_count DESC;

SELECT 
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS record_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    payment_mode_catalog pmc ON ld.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
GROUP BY 
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    record_count DESC;

WITH ranked_products AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        actual_raise_amount,
        minimum_holding_days,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY actual_raise_amount DESC) AS group_seq
    FROM wealth_product
    WHERE status = 'ON_SALE' AND actual_raise_amount IS NOT NULL
),
group_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        group_seq,
        COUNT(*) AS product_count
    FROM ranked_products
    WHERE minimum_holding_days > 0
    GROUP BY group_seq
    HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 31 AND 33
)
SELECT 
    group_seq,
    product_count
FROM group_stats
ORDER BY group_seq ASC;

SELECT 
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS total_revolving_limit,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS disbursement_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    credit_facility cf ON ca.facility_id = cf.facility_id
WHERE 
    cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
    AND ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
ORDER BY 
    total_revolving_limit DESC;

SELECT 
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh,
    COUNT(*) AS pending_instruction_count
FROM 
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    payment_mode_catalog pmc ON pi.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
WHERE 
    pi.status = 'PENDING'
GROUP BY 
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    pending_instruction_count DESC;

SELECT 
    itc.name_zh AS instrument_name_zh,
    sc.name_zh AS status_name_zh
FROM 
    instrument_type_catalog itc
CROSS JOIN 
    status_catalog sc
WHERE 
    sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
ORDER BY 
    itc.name_zh, 
    sc.name_zh;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.staff_id) AS relationship_manager_count
FROM 
    main.organization_unit ou
JOIN 
    main.staff_assignment sa ON ou.org_unit_id = sa.org_unit_id
WHERE 
    sa.role_code = 'RELATIONSHIP_MANAGER'
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    relationship_manager_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    ds.principal_overdue_days,
    ds.overdue_principal
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE 
    ds.principal_overdue_days > 30
    AND cg.grade_code = 'NORMAL'
ORDER BY 
    ds.principal_overdue_days DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE 
    ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ps.provision_stage = 'STAGE_2'
    AND ps.required_amount > 0
    AND (ps.recognized_amount * 1.0 / ps.required_amount) < 0.5
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount), 2) AS total_provision_gap
FROM 
    provision_snapshot p
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON p.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    p.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND p.recognized_amount < p.required_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_provision_gap DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    a.account_subtype,
    ROUND(ABS(bs.ledger_balance), 2) AS ledger_balance
FROM account a
JOIN account_balance_snapshot bs ON a.account_id = bs.account_id
LEFT JOIN account_holder ah ON a.account_id = ah.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'SECONDARY'
WHERE a.status = 'DORMANT'
  AND a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND ah.account_holder_id IS NULL
  AND bs.as_of_date = (
      SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
      FROM account_balance_snapshot 
      WHERE account_id = a.account_id
  )
ORDER BY bs.ledger_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pp.annual_income > 1000000
GROUP BY 
    p.customer_segment
ORDER BY 
    customer_count DESC,
    p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT 
    ma.asset_category_primary,
    COUNT(*) AS asset_count
FROM 
    managed_asset ma
JOIN 
    industry_sector isec ON ma.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE 
    isec.risk_category = 'RESTRICTED'
    AND ma.asset_scope = 'NON_STANDARDIZED'
GROUP BY 
    ma.asset_category_primary
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) < 33
ORDER BY 
    asset_count DESC, 
    ma.asset_category_primary ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    pp.annual_income,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_credit_limit,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS debt_service_ratio
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_facility cf ON p.party_id = cf.obligor_party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
    AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, pp.annual_income
HAVING 
    debt_service_ratio > 3.0
ORDER BY 
    debt_service_ratio DESC, p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    pp.occupation_code,
    pp.employment_sector,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM 
    person_profile pp
GROUP BY 
    pp.occupation_code,
    pp.employment_sector
ORDER BY 
    customer_count DESC,
    pp.occupation_code ASC,
    pp.employment_sector ASC;

SELECT 
    pc.status AS card_status,
    COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM 
    payment_card pc
WHERE 
    pc.card_type = 'DEBIT'
GROUP BY 
    pc.status
ORDER BY 
    card_count DESC,
    card_status ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    payment_card pc ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN 
    party p ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN 
    payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
JOIN 
    card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
WHERE 
    ctc.name_zh = '贷记卡'
    AND pe.is_cash = 1
    AND ptc.name_zh IN ('现金支取', '现金存入')
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    total_amount DESC, ou.unit_name ASC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pc.card_id,
    pc.holder_party_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_card pc ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
WHERE ctc.name_zh = '贷记卡'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id ASC, pc.card_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    pc.holder_party_id,
    COUNT(*) AS cash_transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    payment_card pc ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN 
    card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
JOIN 
    payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
WHERE 
    ctc.name_zh = '贷记卡'
    AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY 
    pc.holder_party_id
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 5
ORDER BY 
    cash_transaction_count DESC,
    total_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    holder_party_id,
    COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM 
    payment_card
GROUP BY 
    holder_party_id
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 3
ORDER BY 
    card_count DESC,
    holder_party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    c.name_zh AS card_type_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(AVG(p.amount), 2) AS avg_single_amount
FROM 
    payment_event p
JOIN 
    account a ON (p.from_account_id = a.account_id OR p.to_account_id = a.account_id)
JOIN 
    payment_card pc ON (a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id)
JOIN 
    card_type_catalog c ON pc.card_type = c.card_type
WHERE 
    p.is_cash = 1
    AND pc.card_type IN ('CREDIT', 'DEBIT')
GROUP BY 
    c.name_zh
ORDER BY 
    avg_single_amount DESC,
    c.name_zh ASC;

SELECT 
    channel,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM 
    payment_event
WHERE 
    status = 'SETTLED'
    AND is_cash = 0
GROUP BY 
    channel
HAVING 
    ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) > 11780000.00
ORDER BY 
    avg_amount DESC,
    channel ASC;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    td.maturity_on,
    a.status
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE 
    td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
    AND td.maturity_on <= '2026-06-30'
    AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    td.maturity_on DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(MAX(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS max_valuation_amount
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING 
    COUNT(cv.valuation_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    max_valuation_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) AS reference_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS distinct_security_count
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING 
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    reference_count DESC,
    ca.collateral_id ASC;

SELECT 
    gc.guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ca.agreement_id,
    ROUND(gc.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS guaranteed_amount,
    ROUND(ld.total_disbursed, 2) AS total_disbursed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        ld_inner.agreement_id,
        SUM(ld_inner.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown ld_inner
    GROUP BY ld_inner.agreement_id
) ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND gc.guaranteed_amount > ld.total_disbursed
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, gc.guarantor_party_id ASC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.borrower_party_id,
    ca.contract_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(sa.secured_amount), 0), 2) AS total_covered_amount,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount - COALESCE(SUM(sa.secured_amount), 0), 2) AS coverage_gap
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    ca.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING 
    coverage_gap > 0
ORDER BY 
    coverage_gap DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(*) AS insufficient_provision_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN 
    provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE 
    rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cg.grade_code = 'SUBSTANDARD'
    AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    insufficient_provision_count DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.borrower_party_id,
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS loan_balance,
    ca.contract_amount AS credit_limit,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount, 2) AS balance_multiple
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND lbs.principal_balance >= 4.0 * ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY 
    balance_multiple DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(*) AS over_provision_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.recognized_amount - ps.required_amount), 2) AS total_over_provision_amount
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id AND rc.as_of_date = ps.as_of_date
WHERE 
    rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
    AND ps.recognized_amount > ps.required_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_name, 
    cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    total_over_provision_amount DESC, 
    i.institution_name ASC, 
    cg.grade_name_zh ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(max_internal.valuation_amount, 2) AS max_internal_value,
    ROUND(max_external.valuation_amount, 2) AS max_external_value,
    ROUND(max_internal.valuation_amount - max_external.valuation_amount, 2) AS undervaluation_diff
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    (SELECT collateral_id, MAX(valuation_amount) AS valuation_amount
     FROM collateral_valuation
     WHERE valuation_type = 'INTERNAL'
     GROUP BY collateral_id) max_internal ON ca.collateral_id = max_internal.collateral_id
JOIN 
    (SELECT collateral_id, MAX(valuation_amount) AS valuation_amount
     FROM collateral_valuation
     WHERE valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL'
     GROUP BY collateral_id) max_external ON ca.collateral_id = max_external.collateral_id
WHERE 
    max_external.valuation_amount < max_internal.valuation_amount
ORDER BY 
    undervaluation_diff DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id AS "抵质押物编号",
    ca.asset_label AS "资产名称",
    ROUND(cv.valuation_amount, 2) AS "最新评估价",
    ROUND(SUM(cl.pledged_amount), 2) AS "累计质押额",
    ROUND(SUM(cl.pledged_amount) - cv.valuation_amount, 2) AS "覆盖缺口"
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
WHERE 
    cv.valued_on = (
        SELECT MAX(valued_on) 
        FROM collateral_valuation 
        WHERE collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
    )
    AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label, cv.valuation_amount
HAVING 
    SUM(cl.pledged_amount) > cv.valuation_amount
ORDER BY 
    "覆盖缺口" DESC;

SELECT 
    g.party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(l.disbursed_amount), 0), 2) AS total_borrowed_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 0), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM 
    guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN 
    party g ON gc.guarantor_party_id = g.party_id
JOIN 
    party p ON g.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON gc.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown l ON ca.agreement_id = l.agreement_id
WHERE 
    gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    g.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 0), 2) > ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(l.disbursed_amount), 0), 2)
ORDER BY 
    total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    ROUND(sa.secured_amount, 2) AS secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE 
    gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING 
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 
    total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pp.is_public_official = 1
    AND pp.annual_income >= 300000
GROUP BY 
    p.customer_segment
ORDER BY 
    customer_count DESC,
    p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    etc.name_zh,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM 
    exposure_group eg
JOIN 
    institution i ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN 
    exposure_group_type_catalog etc ON eg.group_type = etc.group_type
WHERE 
    eg.effective_to IS NULL
    AND egm.effective_to IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_name,
    etc.name_zh
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY 
    member_count DESC;

SELECT 
    egm.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM 
    exposure_group_member egm
JOIN 
    party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY 
    egm.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    group_count DESC,
    egm.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS relation_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS credit_agreement_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON (p.party_id = pr.source_party_id OR p.party_id = pr.target_party_id)
JOIN 
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
LEFT JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE 
    rtc.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM credit_agreement ca2 
        WHERE ca2.borrower_party_id = p.party_id 
        AND ca2.status = 'ACTIVE'
    )
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    relation_count DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON (p.party_id = pr.source_party_id OR p.party_id = pr.target_party_id)
JOIN 
    exposure_group_member egm ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
WHERE 
    pr.relation_type = 'SHADOW_SHAREHOLDER'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    group_count DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    pr.relation_id,
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_src.agreement_id) AS source_contract_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_tgt.agreement_id) AS target_contract_count
FROM 
    party_relation pr
JOIN 
    party p_src ON pr.source_party_id = p_src.party_id
JOIN 
    party p_tgt ON pr.target_party_id = p_tgt.party_id
LEFT JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca_src ON p_src.party_id = ca_src.borrower_party_id AND ca_src.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca_tgt ON p_tgt.party_id = ca_tgt.borrower_party_id AND ca_tgt.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE 
    pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    AND pr.effective_to IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    pr.relation_id, pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_src.agreement_id) > 0 
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT ca_tgt.agreement_id) > 0
ORDER BY 
    (COUNT(DISTINCT ca_src.agreement_id) + COUNT(DISTINCT ca_tgt.agreement_id)) DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ca.collateral_type
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
LEFT JOIN 
    collateral_link cl 
    ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id 
    AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND cl.collateral_link_id IS NULL
ORDER BY 
    ca.collateral_id ASC;

WITH guarantor_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    JOIN security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE' 
      AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
borrower_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_loan_balance
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT 
    ge.guarantor_party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ROUND(ge.total_guaranteed_amount, 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(bl.total_loan_balance, 0.0), 2) AS own_loan_balance,
    ROUND(ge.total_guaranteed_amount - COALESCE(bl.total_loan_balance, 0.0), 2) AS excess_guarantee_amount
FROM guarantor_exposure ge
JOIN party p ON ge.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN borrower_loan_balance bl ON ge.guarantor_party_id = bl.borrower_party_id
WHERE ge.total_guaranteed_amount > COALESCE(bl.total_loan_balance, 0.0)
ORDER BY excess_guarantee_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    gc.guaranteed_amount AS guaranteed_amount,
    gc.status AS guarantee_status
FROM 
    guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN 
    party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE 
    ds.principal_overdue_days > 0
    AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, 
    p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id,
    ROUND(SUM(d.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN 
    managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ma.obligor_party_id = (
        SELECT ca.borrower_party_id 
        FROM credit_agreement ca 
        JOIN loan_drawdown ld_inner ON ca.agreement_id = ld_inner.agreement_id 
        WHERE ld_inner.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot d ON ld.loan_id = d.loan_id
WHERE 
    phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
    AND wp.issuer_institution_id = ca.institution_id
    AND d.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 
    wp.product_name, ma.asset_name, ma.obligor_party_id
HAVING 
    SUM(d.overdue_principal) > 0
ORDER BY 
    wp.product_name ASC, total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_type,
    COUNT(sa.security_id) AS security_count,
    ROUND(SUM(so.covered_amount), 2) AS total_covered_amount
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    sa.security_type
ORDER BY 
    total_covered_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE 
    sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY 
    ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    exposure_group eg
JOIN 
    institution i ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON egm.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id AND eg.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value), 2) AS total_inversion_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS inversion_count
FROM 
    wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
WHERE 
    phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY 
    wp.product_id, wp.product_name
HAVING 
    SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY 
    total_inversion_amount DESC, 
    wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN 
    wealth_product wp ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN 
    managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN 
    party issuer_party ON ma.issuer_party_id = issuer_party.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = issuer_party.party_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE 
    phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
    AND ca.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
GROUP BY 
    wp.product_name, 
    ma.asset_name, 
    phs.lookthrough_depth, 
    phs.carrying_amount
ORDER BY 
    phs.lookthrough_depth DESC, 
    phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT 
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS first_priority_valid_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_sixty_percent_count
FROM 
    collateral_link cl
WHERE 
    cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND cl.lien_priority = 1
GROUP BY 
    cl.collateral_id
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    over_sixty_percent_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    fs.total_assets,
    fs.total_liabilities,
    fs.net_assets,
    fs.annual_revenue
FROM 
    financial_snapshot fs
JOIN 
    institution i ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            party_id, 
            as_of_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY party_id ORDER BY as_of_date DESC) as rn
        FROM 
            financial_snapshot
    ) latest ON fs.party_id = latest.party_id AND fs.as_of_date = latest.as_of_date AND latest.rn = 1
ORDER BY 
    fs.annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.total_liabilities * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 4) AS debt_asset_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON i.institution_id = SUBSTR(fs.party_id, 5)
WHERE 
    fs.party_id LIKE 'PTY-%'
    AND fs.total_assets > 0
ORDER BY 
    debt_asset_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.tier1_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS tier1_ratio
FROM 
    capital_snapshot cs
JOIN 
    institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cs.risk_weighted_assets > 0
ORDER BY 
    tier1_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 6) AS capital_to_asset_ratio
FROM 
    capital_snapshot cs
JOIN 
    institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE 
    cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND fs.total_assets > 0
ORDER BY 
    capital_to_asset_ratio DESC;

WITH institution_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        fs.annual_revenue
    FROM institution i
    JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
    WHERE fs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM financial_snapshot 
        WHERE party_id LIKE 'PTY-%'
    )
),
total_revenue AS (
    SELECT SUM(annual_revenue) AS sum_revenue
    FROM institution_revenue
)
SELECT 
    ir.institution_name,
    ROUND(ir.annual_revenue, 2) AS annual_revenue,
    ROUND(ir.annual_revenue * 1.0 / tr.sum_revenue * 100, 2) AS revenue_ratio
FROM institution_revenue ir
CROSS JOIN total_revenue tr
WHERE (ir.annual_revenue * 1.0 / tr.sum_revenue) > 0.15
ORDER BY revenue_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS inconsistent_asset_count
FROM 
    managed_asset ma
JOIN 
    institution i ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL 
    AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL 
    AND ma.internal_rating != ma.external_rating
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    inconsistent_asset_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ma.valuation_method,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM 
    product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN 
    managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
GROUP BY 
    ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY 
    total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS account_count,
    ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS total_principal
FROM 
    term_deposit td
JOIN 
    account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS deposit_count
FROM 
    term_deposit td
JOIN 
    account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    td.annual_interest_rate > 0.03
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    deposit_count DESC;

SELECT 
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS operator_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.person_party_id) AS staff_count
FROM 
    service_operator so
JOIN 
    staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE 
    sm.employment_type = 'FIXED_TERM'
GROUP BY 
    so.authority_level
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.person_party_id) >= 10
ORDER BY 
    operator_count DESC, 
    so.authority_level ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS deposit_count
FROM 
    term_deposit td
JOIN 
    account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30'
    AND td.maturity_on <= date('2026-06-30', '+30 days')
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    deposit_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS under_provision_total,
    ROUND(fs.net_assets, 2) AS net_assets,
    ROUND((SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) * 1.0 / fs.net_assets) * 100, 2) AS under_provision_ratio_pct
FROM 
    provision_snapshot ps
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE 
    ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.net_assets
HAVING 
    SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) > 0
ORDER BY 
    under_provision_ratio_pct DESC, 
    i.institution_id ASC;

SELECT 
    cg.grade_name_zh AS risk_classification_name,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM 
    risk_classification rc
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE 
    rc.classification_basis = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
    AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
GROUP BY 
    cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC, 
    risk_classification_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS bad_loan_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON ('PTY-' || i.institution_id) = fs.party_id
WHERE 
    ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, fs.annual_revenue
HAVING 
    (SUM(ds.overdue_principal) * 1.0 / NULLIF(fs.annual_revenue, 0)) > 0.5
ORDER BY 
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_principal_balance,
    ROUND(cs.risk_weighted_assets, 2) AS risk_weighted_assets,
    ROUND((SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets) * 100, 2) AS loan_to_rwa_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.risk_weighted_assets
ORDER BY 
    loan_to_rwa_ratio DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    pi.payment_mode,
    COUNT(*) AS instruction_count
FROM 
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE 
    pi.status = 'PENDING'
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    pi.payment_mode
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 45
ORDER BY 
    instruction_count DESC,
    pi.payment_mode ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS abnormal_record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(r.amount_value), 2) AS abnormal_amount,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(fs.total_assets, 2) AS total_assets,
    ROUND((SUM(r.amount_value) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital) * 100, 4) AS ratio_to_net_capital_pct
FROM 
    prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 r
JOIN 
    institution i ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON r.institution_id = cs.institution_id 
    AND cs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot WHERE institution_id = r.institution_id)
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = ('PTY-' || r.institution_id)
    AND fs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM financial_snapshot WHERE party_id = 'PTY-' || r.institution_id)
WHERE 
    r.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY 
    r.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital, fs.total_assets
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 8
ORDER BY 
    ratio_to_net_capital_pct DESC;

WITH overdue_submissions AS (
    SELECT r.institution_id,
           COUNT(*) AS overdue_cnt,
           ROUND(AVG(r.amount_value), 2) AS avg_amount
    FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
    WHERE (r.completion_date IS NULL OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date)
    GROUP BY r.institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 25
),
provision_gap AS (
    SELECT a.institution_id,
           COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS gap_loan_cnt,
           ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount THEN (ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) ELSE 0 END), 2) AS gap_amount
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement a ON a.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    WHERE ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
    GROUP BY a.institution_id
)
SELECT i.institution_name,
       o.overdue_cnt,
       o.avg_amount,
       COALESCE(p.gap_loan_cnt, 0) AS gap_loan_cnt,
       COALESCE(p.gap_amount, 0.00) AS gap_amount
FROM overdue_submissions o
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = o.institution_id
LEFT JOIN provision_gap p ON p.institution_id = o.institution_id
ORDER BY gap_amount DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cf.facility_id) AS total_credit_facilities,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN gcr.exception_flag = 1 THEN gcr.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS governance_exception_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN gcr.exception_flag = 1 THEN gcr.ratio_value END), 4) AS avg_observed_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
JOIN 
    governance_control_record_v3 gcr ON i.institution_id = gcr.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN gcr.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
ORDER BY 
    governance_exception_amount DESC, 
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS target_party_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS relation_type_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_non_related_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN 
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE 
    p.party_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT subject_id 
        FROM related_transaction_record_v3 
        WHERE exception_flag = 1
    )
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    target_party_count DESC, 
    relation_type_count DESC, 
    customer_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS card_holder_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ore.exception_flag = 1 THEN ore.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS operational_risk_abnormal_amount,
    COUNT(ore.record_id) AS operational_risk_valid_record_count
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    payment_card pc ON pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM account a 
        WHERE a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id 
        AND a.institution_id = i.institution_id
    )
LEFT JOIN 
    operational_risk_event_v3 ore ON ore.institution_id = i.institution_id 
    AND ore.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(ore.record_id) >= 43
ORDER BY 
    operational_risk_abnormal_amount DESC, 
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wp.product_id) AS on_sale_product_count,
    ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount), 2) AS total_actual_raise_amount,
    COUNT(pce.record_id) AS conduct_record_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pce.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio_value
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    wealth_product wp ON i.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
JOIN 
    product_conduct_event_v3 pce ON i.institution_id = pce.institution_id
WHERE 
    wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
    AND pce.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(pce.record_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    total_actual_raise_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS asset_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ma.issued_amount), 2) AS total_issued_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ce.record_id) AS custody_valid_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ce.exception_flag = 1 THEN ce.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS abnormal_amount_sum
FROM 
    main.managed_asset ma
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    main.custody_operation_event_v3 ce ON ma.originator_institution_id = ce.institution_id 
    AND ce.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ce.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 END) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    total_issued_amount DESC, 
    i.institution_name ASC;
